messages:
anya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — launching a short Privacy & Acceptable Data Use refresher for everyone (ICs, contractors, temps). Due date: Mon Apr 20. It's a 12-min micro-training + 3 quiz questions. :memo:

saira (HRBP): Link to the training + completion sheet: https://tiny.redwood/priv-refresher — managers, please add completion rows for your teams.

marco (Eng Manager): Question — contractors included? We have two new contractors starting next week.

anya (People Ops): Yes, include contractors and temps. For external consultants that are vendor-managed, please ping me with contract IDs for exceptions.

leo (Eng): Note for engineering managers — completion will be required before folks can be marked eligible in the upcoming performance calibration. Please prioritize.

marco (Eng Manager): Ack. I’ll add it to our 4/18 1:1s and follow up with anyone missing.

nisha (HRIS): Can we get an export of completions for HRIS sync? @ops-bot can you schedule a nightly CSV dump of the sheet?

ops-bot: @nisha scheduled export created: /internal/hr/exports/privacy_refresher_2026-04-18.csv — next run 2026-04-18T02:00Z :robot_face:

anya (People Ops): Also: we’re updating the handbook section on "Data Handling" — small PR is open: https://git.internal/redwood/handbook/pulls/455. Changes: clarify S3 access patterns, KMS key responsibilities, and the exception approval flow.

marco (Eng Manager): Quick clarity check — who signs off on exceptions now, security or legal?

saira (HRBP): For infra-level exceptions, security + legal. For product/data collection exceptions, product PM + legal. I’ll add a decision tree to the handbook PR for faster triage.

leo (Eng): Nice. Can we get a manager reminder one week before the deadline? A Slack nudge would help.

anya (People Ops): Yep — manager reminder scheduled for 2026-04-13. If you want custom text, post it here.

marco (Eng Manager): Please drop the template.

anya (People Ops): Template (paste/modify):
"Hi <manager>, reminder: your team needs to complete the Privacy Refresher by Apr 20. Please update the completion sheet (link above). Reach out to @anya for any exception requests. Thanks!"

nisha (HRIS): I’ll ingest the CSV after the 4/18 run and reconcile with HRIS records; will flag discrepancies to managers on 4/19.

ops-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by ops-bot

anya (People Ops): Thanks all — ping me for any edge cases. I’ll follow up with a brief status update on 4/15.
